description:
Turn the user's CapitalSnitch email alerts on or off (Edge plan): instant watchlist alerts, market-wide 'big
insider moves' alerts, and the daily briefing email. Omit a setting to leave it unchanged; call with no settings to
see the current ones. Use for 'alert me about any big insider buys', 'stop the daily email', 'turn my alerts on'.
Never counts toward the daily limit.

big_moves_alerts.description: Email alerts for major insider moves across the WHOLE market: CEO/CFO purchases of $1M+ and high-conviction cluster buying, even outside the watchlist.
